The readable portion of a New York Times report says proposed US restrictions on remote AI-chip access are unsettling Southeast Asian data-center investment tied to Chinese customers. It describes the region’s role as an offshore computing hub and government concerns about export-control workarounds.

The article was only partly readable and does not replace the official rule text. Investigations and disputed personal allegations are not legal findings, and the excerpt does not establish final compliance deadlines, exceptions or the fate of every regional project.
highlights: Policy is described as a proposal
Partial article cannot settle legal obligations
Disputed allegations remain distinct from findings
